title: Console
vsMod.howTo: Install “Vintage RCON” into the server's Mods folder and start the server once: the mod writes ModConfig/vsrcon.json. The dashboard never shows the stored console password, so choose a new one and set it in both places: stop the server, enter it as “Password” in vsrcon.json, enter the same value on this server's edit page under “Console password” → “New password”, then start the server. If that card says the password comes from an env variable, put that variable's value into vsrcon.json instead. The set-up guide has the steps.
